shots.focal_element: Centered white headline over diagonal gradient stripes that resolve into an isometric wall of dashboard thumbnails
shots.transition_other: graphic continuation: thin radial line from the previous sunburst graphic gives way to diagonal gradient stripes sweeping across the frame
on_screen_text: Capture it all in real time
shots.typography: Bold geometric/humanist sans, sentence case, normal tracking, white with a soft drop shadow, single line; font guess (low confidence): Datadog brand sans similar to Noto Sans/Bold
shots.what_happens: Diagonal pink-to-violet gradient stripes slide across a gradient field while the headline holds center; the stripes thin into a lattice that reveals a tilted isometric grid of many small dark dashboard screenshots behind them.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centered bold white headline over a full-bleed gradient, animate 45-degree gradient bars sliding diagonally in staggered layers, then fade the bars' opacity down to reveal a CSS-3D-rotated (rotateX/rotateZ) grid of dashboard screenshot tiles beneath.

shots.focal_element: A single isometric-tilted dark Datadog dashboard with large green, amber and red metric tiles under a centered white headline
shots.transition_other: continuous camera move: the isometric dashboard grid from the previous shot narrows to a diagonal row of tiles, then one dashboard is isolated and enlarged
shots.typography: Same bold sans as s006, sentence case, white with soft drop shadow, centered single line; dashboard UI text (metric values such as 230.5K, 4.33s, 35.85%) is in-product and not counted
shots.what_happens: A diagonal row of dashboard thumbnails slides across stripes, then the frame settles on one large isometric dashboard on a magenta-to-violet gradient while the headline appears; near the end white tilted tiles with integration logos (e.g. Slack, Cisco, GitLab) start flying in around the dashboard and the background lightens.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a dashboard screenshot on a plane rotated about 55 degrees on X and -30 degrees on Z with a soft glow shadow over a gradient, fade-up a centered headline, and at the end spawn white logo cards on the same isometric plane that slide in from the edges.

shots.shot_type_other: multi-scene segment within one detected shot: isometric integration logo wall, kinetic-type card, then UI screen recording with a label badge
shots.focal_element: Sequentially: the '450+ integrations' headline over an isometric logo wall, the 'Cut through the complexity' type card, then the Watchdog anomaly chart with an orange label badge
shots.transition_other: integration logo tiles fly in around the dashboard and fill the frame, replacing it
shots.typography: Bold sans throughout, sentence case. Integrations line in dark navy over white tiles; 'Cut through the complexity' larger, two lines, centered, deep violet with a slight blue-violet gradient; 'AI-powered anomaly detection' white bold on an orange-to-amber parallelogram badge with a slanted edge; final 'Actionable, customized alerts' small white bold on an orange wipe panel
shots.what_happens: An isometric wall of white integration logo tiles drifts diagonally under a dark headline; a lavender diagonal panel wipes in to a soft pale gradient card where 'Cut through the complexity' scales up slightly and holds; this cuts to a light-theme Watchdog screen recording whose latency chart pushes in on a highlighted pink anomaly region while an orange 'AI-powered anomaly detection' badge slides in from the left; an orange diagonal panel then wipes across to start the alerts card.
shots.build_rebuild: Chain three scenes in one timeline: a rotated grid of logo cards translating diagonally with a headline, a diagonal mask wipe into a centered two-line type card that scales from 0.95 to 1, and a screenshot pan/zoom toward a highlighted chart region with a skewed orange label badge sliding in from x:-100%, ending with a diagonal orange panel wipe.

shots.focal_element: Centered white headline in front of a large outlined exclamation mark on an orange gradient
shots.transition_other: diagonal orange colour-panel wipe sweeping over the previous UI shot
shots.typography: Bold sans, sentence case, normal tracking, white, single centered line; the exclamation mark is a thin pink-red outline stroke, not type
shots.what_happens: An outlined exclamation mark sits behind the headline and jitters/echoes with multiple offset strokes; the background shifts from orange to a pink-orange gradient while several outlined exclamation marks rotate outward radially from the right side.
shots.build_rebuild: Draw an SVG outline exclamation mark (rect plus circle stroke) behind a centered white headline, duplicate it with small offset echo strokes for a shake, then clone it into a radial burst rotating outward while tweening the background gradient from orange to pink.

shots.shot_type_other: motion-graphic integration icon cluster (third-party tool logos in circular badges)
shots.focal_element: Ring of six circular app-logo badges (e.g. Jira, Slack, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Gmail, Opsgenie-like icon) with red alert dots that flip to green check marks
shots.what_happens: Six desaturated logo badges arranged in a loose ring each carry a red exclamation notification dot on a violet-magenta gradient; the badges glow and briefly blur while the background shifts to a teal-to-blue gradient, then they reappear in full colour with green check-mark badges, with thin outlined rectangles radiating outward in the background.
shots.build_rebuild: Arrange six circular logo badges in a ring with red '!' notification dots, then in a 0.5s beat tween background gradient from magenta to teal, flash each badge with a glow/blur, swap grayscale logos to colour and pop green check badges in with a small scale overshoot.
